agent_notes: All five supplied 2025 NIRF government-directory pages contain the assigned institution name and Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh.
The official Contact page confirms the campus address in Bareilly and identifies the institution as a State Public University.
The campus catalogue lists 38 entries under University Campus; campus duration and eligibility were not stated, so those fields remain null.
The official site separately labels UG, PG and Ph.D. pages as affiliated-college catalogues; those offerings were not merged into this university-campus record.

The CDOE catalogue lists distinct distance/online undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, but also mixes programme rows with syllabus or unit downloads; only clearly identifiable base programmes were recorded.
The site has a current AEDP page whose 2026 new-programmes PDF is image-only and did not expose programme names in text, so the catalogue cannot be treated as complete.
A malformed campus catalogue entry appears exactly as Mathemetics under Professional PG Courses and was retained with a low-confidence mapping.
No duration or eligibility was imported for campus courses because the official campus catalogue does not state them.

Normal TLS verification produced the exact managed-network error self signed certificate in certificate chain for expected public hosts; curl --insecure was used only for public GETs to the expected NIRF, search, and mjpru.ac.in hosts.
